book.name: Jeramaiya
book.title: Jeramaiya Jeramaiya Bin Gibit Wed Brom God

content: YAWEI bin meigim gudbala pramis
Wal YAWEI bin tok langa detlot boswan, “Ai garra panishim yumob hubin oldei binijimap en spredimat ol main pipul olabat.
Yumob nomo bin lukaftumbat main pipul olabat. Yumob bin spredimat olabat en yumob bin andimwei olabat. Wal ai garra panishim yumob blanga ol detlot nogudbala ting weya yumob bin oldei dumbat.

Bat ai garra majurrumap main pipul olabat brom ebri kantri weya aibin spredimat olabat, en ai garra bringimbek olabat langa olabat ronwan kantri na. Olabat garra abum detmatj biginini en olabat garra jidan bigismob du.
Ai garra pikimat sambala boswan blanga lukaftumbat olabat. Main pipul olabat kaan bradin enimo, en ai kaan panishim olabat igin.

“Wal det taim im kaminap na, wen ai garra pikimat wanbala gudbala king brom detlot biginini blanga Deibid. Det king garra jidan brabli klebawan bos, en im garra dum ebrijing raitwei en gibit ebribodi feyago langa dijan kantri.
Wen im garra jidan king, ol detlot pipul brom Juda garra jidan seifwan, en ol detlot pipul brom Isreil garra jidanbat gudwei du. Olabat garra gulum det neim blanga det king, YAWEI Bin Seibum Wi.
“Tudei wen pipul tok garram main neim, olabat tok, ‘Trubala ai dalim yu. YAWEI na det witnis wanim ai garra tok. Im na bin bringimap detlot Isreil pipul brom Ijip.’

Bat det taim im kaminap wen olabat garra tok, ‘Trubala ai dalim yu. YAWEI na det witnis wanim ai garra tok. Im na bin bringimat detlot Isreil pipul brom det nowathsaid kantri en brom ol detlot najalot kantri weya imbin jandim olabat.’” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
Jeramaiya bin tok blanga detlot laiyawan mesinja

Wen mi jinggabat detlot laiyawan mesinja, mi brabli nogudbinji, en mi sheiksheikbat nomo lilbit, jis laiga drangginbala, dumaji YAWEI bin tok strongbalawei langa detlot mesinja, garram im holiwan wed.

Dijan kantri im garram bigismob pipul hu nomo jidan trubalawei langa YAWEI. Olabat jidan garram brabli nogudbala laif, en olabat oldei dumbat nogudbala ting garram olabat ronwan pawa. Dumaji YAWEI bin brabli nogudbinji, imbin meigim det kantri jidan brabli nogudwan du, en nomo eni gras jidan deya na, najing.
Wal YAWEI det trubala God bin tok, “Detlot mesinja en serramonimen nomo bulurrum mi. Aibin luk olabat bin dumbat nogudbala ting insaid langa det Serramoni Pleis.

Detlot roud weya olabat oldei bulurrumbat dei jidan brabli slipriwan en dakbala. Ai garra meigim olabat buldanbat, en ai garra bringimap nogudbala ting langa olabat. En det taim blanga olabat panishmen im kaminap na.
Aibin luk wanim nogudbala ting detlot mesinjamob bin oldei dumbat langa Sameriya. Olabat bin oldei toktokbat garram det neim blanga Beil. Deibin lidimbat main pipul olabat nogudbalawei.

En aibin luk detlot mesinja langa Jerusalem bin dumbat brabli nogudbala ting du. Olabat oldei silipsilipbat garram najalot gel, en olabat oldei dalimbat laiya. Olabat oldei albumbat ola pipul blanga dumbat nogudbala ting, wulijim ebribodi nomo stap dumbat nogudwan ting. Langa mi, olabat brabli nogudbala du, jis laik detlot pipul langa Sadam en Gamora.

“Wal dijan na wanim mi na tok blanga ol detlot mesinja langa Jerusalem. Ai garra gibit olabat brabli nogudwan plent blanga dagadagatbat, en poisinbala blanga dringgimbat, dumaji olabat bin meigim ebribodi langa dijan kantri jidan brabli nogudwan.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

Wal YAWEI det boswan God bin dalim detlot pipul brom Jerusalem, “Yumob nomo lisin langa detlot mesinja. Olabat oldei bilimap yumob laif garram laiyawan wed. Olabat oldei dalimbat yumob wanim olabat oldei jinggabat, en nomo wanim aibin dalimbat olabat.

Langa detlot pipul hu nomo irrim wanim ai oldei dalimbat olabat, dei kipgon toktokbat ebrijing garra jidan gudwei garram olabat. En langa detlot pipul hu nomo laigim irrim wanim mi dalimbat olabat, dei oldei tok det nogudbala ting kaan kaman langa olabat.” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.

Wal aibin tok na, “Dislot mesinja nomo bin sabi det sigridwan main blanga YAWEI. Nomo eni dislot pipul bin irrim o sabi det mesij, en olabat nomo bin irrim en teiknodis wanim imbin oldei dalimbat olabat.
Wal im brabli wail na, jis laik det stom weya kaman garram bigwan win, en det win im brabli strongwan langa detlot nogudbala pipul,
en im kaan neba stap raidap im garra dum ebrijing im wandim dum. Wen det dei garra kaman bambai im pipul olabat garra sabi.” Lagijat na aibin tok.
YAWEI bin tok, “Ai nomo bin jandim dislot mesinja, bat dei reken dei toktok blanga mi. Ai nomo bin gibit olabat wed, bat dei kipgon toktokbat.
If dei bina irrim mi, dei bina tok main wed en meigim main pipul olabat libum olabat nogudbalawei.
“Bat mi na det God hu jidan ebriweya! Ai nomo jidan oni langa wanbala pleis! Detlot mesinja reken ai kaan luk wanim olabat dumbat!
Nobodi kaan blandim miselp brom mi! Mi jidan ebriweya langa skai en langa graun du.

“Aibin irrim detlot mesinja tok, ‘Irrim! Ai garra dalim yumob blanga drim weya God bin gibit langa mi naitaim.’ Lagijat na dei oldei kipgon yusumbat main neim blanga dalimbat laiya. Wal wotaim diskain ting garra stap?
Haulong detlot mesinja garra trikimbat main pipul olabat garram laiyawan wed?
Olabat reken detlot drim weya dei oldei dalimbat main pipul olabat meigim olabat fogedabat mi, jis laik olabat grengrenfathamob bin fogedabat mi en olabat bin bulurrum det drimin sheip gulum Beil.

Det mesinja hubin abum drim, garra tok, ‘Im oni drim,’ bat det mesinja hubin irrim main mesij garra tok det mesij trubalawei. Det draiwan gras im nomo gudwan wen yu garram gudwan sid daga blanga dagat.
Blanga main mesij im jis laiga faiya, en im jis laiga hema weya im breikimap detlot rok haf en haf.
Ai garra jidan enami blanga detlot mesinja hu oldei dalimbat detlot wed brom najalot mesinja, en olabat toktok dislot mesij bin kaman brom mi.
Ai garra jidan enami blanga detlot mesinja hu oldei toktokbat garram olabat ronwan wed en olabat tok dislot wed bin kaman brom mi.

Wal yumob irrim wanim ai garra tok na. Ai jidan enami blanga detlot mesinja hu oldei dalimbat yumob laiya blanga olabat drim. Olabat oldei dalim yumob blanga detlot drim en olabat lidimbat main pipul olabat rongwei garram olabat laiyawan wed, en olabat oldei meigim miselp haibala. Ai nomo bin jandim olabat en ai nomo bin gibit olabat oda blanga go, en olabat nomo gudwan blanga albumbat ola pipul.”
Detlot laiyinwan mesinja

YAWEI bin kipgon tok, “Jeramaiya, if eni mesinja o serramonimen o jis odinri men tok langa yu, ‘Wanim wori YAWEI bin gibit langa yu?’ Yu garra tok, ‘Yu na det wori blanga YAWEI en im garra tjakidawei yu.’
If enibodi tok, ‘Ai garram wed brom YAWEI’, nomeda im jidan mesinja, o serramonimen o im jis odinri men, ai garra panishim im en im femilimob.
Bat dei garra askim olabat rileishan en frenmob, ‘Wanim YAWEI bin tok langa yu?’

Wal olabat kaan yusum detlot wed, ‘Ai garram wed brom YAWEI’ enimo. Wen dei tok lagijat dei jis twistimran main wed en meigim im jidan laiyawan. Dei garra jinggabat tharran, dumaji mi na yumob ronwan God. Mi na YAWEI det brabli haibala boswan God.
Jeramaiya, yu go en askim ol detlot mesinja, ‘Wanim ensa YAWEI bin gibit langa yumob? Wanim YAWEI bin tok?’
En if dei tok, ‘Ai garram wed brom YAWEI,’ wal yu garra dalim olabat,
‘Ai garra pikimap olabat en tjakam olabat longwei brom mi. Ai garra dum tharran langa olabat pipul en langa olabat taun du, det taun Jerusalem, weya aibin gibit olabat en olabat grengrenfathamob.
Ai garra meigim olabat jidan brabli sheimwan olagijawan en nobodi kaan fogedabat tharran.’” Lagijat na YAWEI bin tok.
